name: Common Port Lookup
description: Look up the protocol and purpose of common ports by number or service name.

hints.query: Accepts a port number (443), a service name (https) or a protocol (udp); typing filters locally, there is nothing to run.
hints.output: Every common port is listed by default; typing a search term or picking a category narrows the list instantly, row by row as "port / service / protocol / purpose".

faq.q: Is this the authoritative port list?
faq.a: It is a snapshot of the ports that matter most in daily operations and development; specific deployments may differ, so trust the running service.

faq.q: Why does one port appear under several categories?
faq.a: It does not. Every row carries exactly one service category; only the protocol column may list both TCP and UDP.
49 in total, focused on the ports you meet in operations and development rather than the full IANA registry.
